title: Evaluation of the explicit Zariski module h-map
statement: For arbitrary schemes X,Y, g:Y to X, modules F,G, phi:F to g_*G, degree q and x in CoherentEtale.Source(X,F,q), zariskiModuleHMap(g,phi,q)(x) [def-pbc-qcoherent-zariski-cohomology-map] equals the large-Ext map obtained by applying Sheaf.H.mapFunctor with invImage(g) and constIso(g).symm, followed by Sheaf.H.map of coeff(g,phi) [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. This is the evaluation formula for the existing definition, with no module cohomology or resolution comparison.

source.place: Tag 01FB; evaluation of the explicit abelian inverse-image Ext construction

proof.text: Unfold zariskiModuleHMap. The pullback functor, constant-integer comparison, and adjoint coefficient map are definitionally invImage(g), constIso(g).symm and coeff(g,phi). The underlying coefficient morphism has the same components as moduleAbelianHMap. Its naturality proof is immaterial by proof irrelevance. Evaluate the composite additive homomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem zariskiModuleHMap_formula {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward g).obj G)
    (q : ℕ) (x : CoherentEtale.Source X F q) :
    Sheaf.H.map.{u + 1} (coeff g φ) q
      (Sheaf.H.mapFunctor.{u + 1} (invImage g) (constIso g).symm
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf X.ringCatSheaf).obj F) q x) =
      zariskiModuleHMap g φ q x
